method: Isolated real CPU inference, raw unmasked input. Existing 30-case corpus is comparative development, not newly blind acceptance. No claims about browser/WASM quality/performance. rows.source: A continuous function on a closed interval attains a maximum. This theorem does not require the function to be differentiable throughout the interval. The maximum need not occur at an endpoint.
rows.baselineTarget: Sebuah fungsi kontinu pada interval tertutup mencapai maksimum. Teorema ini tidak memerlukan fungsi menjadi dapat diturunkan sepanjang interval. Maksimum tidak harus terjadi di sebuah titik akhir.
rows.candidateTarget: Fungsi berterusan pada interval tertutup mencapai maksimum. teori ini tidak memerlukan fungsi untuk dapat dibedakan sepanjang interval.

rows.source: The derivative determines a local rate of change, not the accumulated change over the entire interval. Integration can recover the accumulated change when the required hypotheses hold.
rows.baselineTarget: Turunan menentukan tingkat lokal perubahan, bukan perubahan yang terkumpul selama interval. Integrasi dapat memulihkan perubahan yang terkumpul ketika hipotesis yang dibutuhkan masih kuat.
rows.candidateTarget: Derivat menentukan kadar perubahan lokal, bukan perubahan terkumpul sepanjang interval. integrasi dapat memulihkan perubahan terkumpul ketika hipotesis yang diperlukan tetap.

rows.source: A nonempty finite set has a greatest element under a suitable ordering. Removing the finiteness assumption changes the problem. The claim is about the ordering of elements and not about their physical size.
rows.baselineTarget: Sebuah elemen tunggal himpunan hingga memiliki elemen terbesar di bawah pesanan yang sesuai. Menghapus asumsi terbatas mengubah masalah. Klaim ini tentang pemesanan elemen dan bukan tentang ukuran fisik mereka.
rows.candidateTarget: Set finite nonempty memiliki elemen terbesar di bawah pesanan yang sesuai. menghapus asumsi finiteness mengubah masalah. tuntutan adalah tentang pesanan elemen dan bukan tentang ukuran fisik mereka.

rows.source: Dissolving sugar in water increases the mass of the solution. Evaporation removes some of the water but does not remove the dissolved sugar. The remaining liquid therefore has a higher concentration.
rows.baselineTarget: Dissolving sugar in water increases the mass of the solution. Evaporation removes some of the water but does not remove the dissolved sugar. The remaining liquid therefore has a higher concentration.

rows.source: The catalyst was recovered after the experiment and reused. Recovery alone does not demonstrate that no material was lost; the initial and final masses must be compared.

rows.source: The solution contained 6 mmol of dissolved salt in 2 L of solvent. Adding another 2 L of solvent lowered the concentration while preserving the amount of salt, provided that none of the solution was spilled.

rows.source: A confidence interval describes uncertainty under the assumed sampling procedure. It should not be interpreted as the range containing all individual observations. These are different statistical quantities.
